zh:
从模糊需求出发，通过可验证的最小闭环、验收指标与可靠交接，交付能持续运行的 AI 系统。

12.1 FDE 的完整交付链：问题到运行结果

技术交付不是“模型能回答一个示例”。应把真实工作流、数据权限、业务验收、安全降级和交接放进同一个决策链。

Ambiguous request
 → discover constraints and baseline
 → define success + non-goals
 → walking skeleton
 → evaluated thin slice
 → shadow / canary release
 → operating owner + handoff

12.2 Requirements Discovery：问能改变架构的问题

维度客户问题决定什么
结果改善谁的哪一步？对比哪个 baseline？成功指标
权限什么数据？谁能读写？身份 / RLS / VPC
失败答错与拒答哪个损失更大？HITL / gate
运行多快、多少并发、谁维护？SLO / cost / owner

记录假设时注明证据、owner、验证动作和决策时间；会议里说过不代表已确认为需求。

12.3 Walking Skeleton：优先跑通最薄的真实闭环

ONE customer identity
 → ONE authorized data source
 → ONE realistic task
 → ONE production-shaped deployment path
 → ONE trace and acceptance assertion

一份完美 Notebook 不证明集成成功。最小闭环必须尽早跨越网络、认证、数据获取、执行、可观测和回滚边界；再决定是否需要多 Agent。

12.4 Scope：把 In / Out 与验收写在同一页

项目In scopeOut of scope
用户指定的已授权支持团队公司所有团队
工作流解释一类订单异常并提供证据修改全部订单及自动退款
评估标注集、权限测试、延迟预算“展示时看起来不错”

12.5 Acceptance Contract：把正确、时延、成本、风险分开

维度指标示例对应失败
业务每个已核验任务节省的人工时间没有实际价值
质量真实样本 correct/grounded rate只在演示样本好看
安全越权读取和工具拒绝测试模型口头保证安全
可靠性p95 latency、timeout、rollback平均数掩盖尾部故障
经济性Cost per successful approved task仅优化每 Token 成本

12.6 向非工程师解释取舍：决策 / 收益 / 风险 / 证据

示例：发票精确查询优先试用 permission-filtered Exact/BM25 路径，因为来源与权限容易审计；如果评估发现同义改写召回不足，再加入 Dense 检索。不是预设 BM25 永远优于向量检索。

12.7 Live Demo 故障：透明恢复优于掩饰

时刻行动
演示前核对权限、实时服务、数据刷新时间和已知成功请求
发生故障明确失败步骤与客户影响，记录 trace
降级回放必须标记为录制/样例，不伪称实时成功
后续给出 owner、复现步骤和交付决策

12.8 Handoff：离开后系统仍能被可靠运行

交接最小集包含：数据契约、租户权限、版本化 Eval Suite、仪表盘、SLO、Incident Runbook、成本预算、发布/回滚说明、明确的值班与升级负责人。

12.9 场景演练：紧急服务响应时间

客户希望降低急救响应时间。先拆成接线、人工分诊、定位、派单、行车和记录延迟，确认决定权必须在合格的人类调度员手中。第一阶段可以是经过审核的辅助转录/信息整理，而非自动调度。

若最大的瓶颈是路况和行车时间，部署 LLM 文本助手很可能没有意义。强 FDE 会证明或否定这个假设，而不是强行套 AI 架构。

FDE 原始 TrackHandbook 责任章节

Retrieval & Agents02–08；评价归 09，Text-to-SQL 归 11

MLOps & Lifecycle09/10；Feature Store 归 11
ML Infrastructure & Serving10；蒸馏归 01

端到端 FDE System Design：企业订单异常调查 Copilot §12.11

合成客户场景：售后团队经常遇到订单“签收时间早于交接时间”的异常。任务不是快速套用 Agent 框架，而是设计一个能被授权、能解释、能复查、能交付的调查流程。

TEACHING CASE · SOURCE BOUNDARY

所有客户、订单、时间及目标均为虚构。架构建议是 Handbook 综合判断；真实平台事实另外列出官方来源。示例代码可运行，但不是生产系统。

需求发现：先判断 AI 值不值得做 01

客户要什么FDE 必须追问改变的架构决策
调查效率哪一步最慢？基线多少？是否真的需要 LLM
事实准确谁定义最终订单状态？各来源时钟可靠么？来源优先级与不确定性

处理异常只解释，还是允许退款？谁审批？Read-only / human approval
实时性源变更多久后必须可查？Batch vs streaming CDC
关键边界

第一阶段只交付：一个已授权订单、可溯源事件、只读调查、人工确认。自动退款、开放 SQL、多 Agent 都明确排除。

四个平面，七个边界：完整系统拓扑 02

FIG.12.FDE-01 · KNOWLEDGE / DATA / EXECUTION

从客户身份到经过核验的订单结论

01

CUSTOMER

SSO / 用户身份 / 验收人
02

POLICY GATE

Tenant + 工单授权 + 工具权限
03

TASK ROUTE

订单号 → Exact SQL 路径

↓

04

DATA PLANE

OMS / Carrier → CDC → Bronze / Silver / Gold
05

这些是有先后依赖的工程边界，不是让三个 Agent 分头猜答案。关键原则是：模型不能提供或更改身份，不能代替数据库授权，也不能把自己的解释当成事实来源。

CDC / Delta：证据的时间与来源比模型更重要 03

OMS / WMS / carrier source events
  → raw append + source offset (Bronze)
  → schema / event-ID dedup / tombstone / replay (Silver)
  → governed order timeline + business semantics (Gold)
  → index only optional policy documents
字段为什么必须存在最容易出错的地方
source_event_id重试幂等、证据引用一个 ID 重用不同 payload
source_version某个来源的版本次序跨来源比较版本号
event_time_utc业务事件声称发生的时间把时钟偏差当真实异常
ingested_at_utc观测到的写入时间当成 event time 排序
tenant_id隔离/授权边界来自模型、缺行级策略

官方 Delta 文档明确说明：CDF 不是默认开启、仅记录启用后的更改，历史受保留策略限制。长期审计必须另行存档；不能把 CDF 当成无限期的原始事实库。

路由：订单事实走 Exact SQL，政策才考虑 RAG 04

输入选择的路径为什么不用另一个方案
订单 42 状态授权 Exact / SQL向量相似度不能保证唯一 ID
Carrier SLA 条款权限过滤后 BM25 / DenseSQL 事件表没有非结构化条款
缺少交接事件拒判 / 人工复核LLM 不能补造证据
订单退款草稿 + Host 审批；首期禁用模型决策不能直接执行业务写入
trusted_identity + allowed_orders
 → authorize BEFORE retrieve
 → SQL WHERE tenant_id = ? AND order_id = ?
 → verify handoff + delivery evidence
 → ANOMALY / CONSISTENT / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
 → explain observed evidence; never issue refund
关键边界

即使查询只返回 SELECT，SQL 也不是自动安全：必须由受信服务实施租户约束，并在数据库层提供真正的行级执行策略。

可运行的 Walking Skeleton：同一订单号、不同租户 05

在仓库运行纯 Python 标准库测试。案例故意让 tenant-a 和 tenant-b 都拥有订单号 42，分别产生异常与正常结论，验证查询条件和证据引用不会跨租户串线。

cd examples/fde-order-copilot
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
python3 copilot.py

Browse runnable Python and tests

TENANT A异常订单 42
DELIVERED 10:20 · HANDED_OFF 10:30

记录上的时间顺序异常；不能断言真实物流已经发生逆序。

TENANT B正常订单 42
HANDED_OFF 11:00 · DELIVERED 11:30

同一个 ID，但数据、身份、证据完全独立。

脚本演示授权过滤、重复事件、乱序到达、证据不足和拒绝未知动作；它不包含生产认证、真实 Delta、LLM 或退款 API，因此不能当作一次生产安全认证。

Failure Injection：出现问题必须知道在哪一层修 06

场景 A · Carrier Event 晚到/重复

保留 event time 与 ingest time；重复事件必须幂等，冲突 payload 必须隔离。先修 CDC 数据契约，而不是修改 Prompt。

场景 B · 同一个订单号跨租户重复

没有可信 Tenant Context 的查询必须失败。测试检索候选、最终证据、缓存及可观测日志，不能只检查最终 LLM 回复。

场景 C · HANDOFF 记录缺失

输出 INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE、缺失事件与下一步人工核对，不可编造一个完整时间线。

场景 D · 退款 Tool 超时

首期根本不开放退款。若后期接入，超时意味着结果未知；需授权审批、持久化操作 ID、下游幂等契约与对账，不能无限重试。

验收与发布：正确率不能隐藏权限问题 07

Gate如何测试Release 判定
Tenant isolation跨租户、撤权、缓存重用观察到越权则阻断
Evidence / abstentionGolden timeline + 缺失记录样本无法支持结论必须拒判
Data freshness每来源源提交→可查询延迟阈值由客户协商
p95 & failures端到端、超时、重试、回滚分阶段 canary
Business impact人工复核后用时与 baseline确认真实节省时间
Cost per success所有运行费用 / 正确且被接受的任务不只看 token 价格

用于估算的示例：若人工平均调查 12 分钟、Copilot 复核总计 5 分钟，则推导节省 7 分钟——这只是算术情景，不是实测结果。真实 Pilot 必须匹配任务难度，记录尾延迟、拒判与安全失败。

生产上线、交接，以及五分钟 FDE 答题骨架 08

决策点推荐起点什么时候需要升级
部署满足客户约束的 Managed SaaSVPC/BYOC、数据驻留或合同要求
Agent确定性 Host Workflow审批/长期运行/可恢复分支
检索ID Exact SQL非结构化合同、政策、SLA
模型事件分类无需 LLM已证实需要语言解释或复杂证据推理

交接物必须包含数据契约、身份策略、版本化 Golden Set、Release Gate、SLO、费用预算、告警、Runbook、Rollback、值班人与升级责任。FDE 真正的完工标准是：你离开后其他工程师也能解释并修复故障。

关键边界

面试回答优先级：澄清真实问题 → 明确权限与事实来源 → 最薄闭环 → 拒判/安全关卡 → Golden Eval 与成本 → 逐步上线与交接。不要先背技术栈。

可直接验证的外部来源： Delta CDF · Delta Streaming · Databricks Unity Catalog · Azure Document ACL · AWS Idempotency

FDE 167 概念审计：定位知识，而非制造完成率

保留原始 10 Track、167 题的唯一主章节映射，并逐项检查当前 Handbook 章节中是否存在直观的知识证据。以 2026-10-08 当前工作分支为基线；原理正确性和面试准备程度仍需单独审查。

证据等级数量应如何解读
H99章节标题出现术语或审核过的别名；不是完整覆盖认证。
B31正文出现术语或别名，需要继续审查解释深度。
N37无直接字面命中；可能确实缺失，也可能因中文同义说法漏检。
不能将命中率当学习进度

即使出现标题，也必须核对机制、案例、取舍、故障、指标、官方来源六个维度。三种等级都不能直接宣称某概念已完全掌握。

en:
Turn ambiguous customer requests into measurable AI deliveries using thin slices, explicit acceptance and reliable handoffs.

12.1 FDE delivery chain: from ambiguous ask to operating outcome

Delivery is not a model answering one polished example. The customer workflow, data access, acceptance conditions, safe degradation and handoff belong to one decision chain.

Ambiguous request
 → discover constraints and baseline
 → define success + non-goals
 → walking skeleton
 → evaluated thin slice
 → shadow / canary release
 → operating owner + handoff

12.2 Requirements discovery: ask architecture-changing questions

LensCustomer questionDetermines
OutcomeWhich step improves vs what baseline?Success metric
AccessWhich data, who may read or write?Identity / RLS / VPC
FailureWhich is worse: wrong answer or abstention?HITL / gate
OperationsHow fast, concurrent, and who operates it?SLO / cost / owner

For each assumption log evidence, owner, validation action and decision date; a meeting remark is not automatically a confirmed requirement.

12.3 Walking skeleton: prove the thinnest real end-to-end slice

ONE customer identity
 → ONE authorized data source
 → ONE realistic task
 → ONE production-shaped deployment path
 → ONE trace and acceptance assertion

A polished notebook cannot prove integration. Cross network, identity, ingestion, execution, observability and rollback boundaries early; add multi-agent orchestration only when evidence requires it.

12.4 Scope: write in/out boundaries beside acceptance

ItemIn scopeOut of scope
UsersNamed authorized support teamEvery team in the company
WorkflowExplain one order anomaly with evidenceEdit all orders or auto-refund
EvaluationLabeled evals, access tests, latency budgetA demo that merely looks good

12.5 Acceptance contract: correctness, latency, cost and risk

DimensionExample metricFailure caught
BusinessTime saved per verified taskNo real customer value
QualityCorrect/grounded rate on held-out tasksDemo-only overfitting
SecurityUnauthorized-read / tool-denial testsVerbal safety promise
Reliabilityp95 latency, timeout, rollbackAverages hide tail failures
EconomicsCost per successful approved taskToken cost mistaken for value

12.6 Explain trade-offs: decision, benefit, risk, evidence

Example: start invoice-ID lookup with permission-filtered Exact/BM25 for auditability, then add dense retrieval if labeled tests show insufficient paraphrase recall. This is not a universal claim that BM25 always beats vectors.

12.7 Failed live demos: transparent recovery beats performance

MomentAction
PreflightCheck identity, service health, freshness, and known-good request
FailureExplain the failed boundary and impact; capture the trace
FallbackMark prerecorded or simulated paths; never imply live success
Follow-upProvide owner, reproduction, and next decision

12.8 Handoff: reliable operation without the original FDE

A handoff needs data contracts, tenant policies, versioned evals, a dashboard, SLO, incident runbook, cost budget, release/rollback instructions, and an on-call owner.

12.9 Case study: emergency-response delay

A city wants faster emergency response. Measure call intake, human triage, location, dispatch, travel and reporting separately. Keep high-stakes dispatch authority with qualified humans. A first slice may be audited assistive transcription, not autonomous dispatch.

If travel dominates the delay, an LLM intake agent is likely the wrong investment. A strong FDE tests that hypothesis rather than forcing an AI solution.

Retrieval & Agents02–08; evals 09, Text-to-SQL 11
Evaluation & ML Foundations01 foundations + 09 evals

MLOps & Lifecycle09/10; feature stores 11
ML Infrastructure & Serving10; distillation 01
Data & SQL Engineering11 data and SQL

Coding & Engineering Craft01/02/08/10/11 by responsibility

End-to-end FDE system design: Enterprise Order Investigation Copilot §12.11

Synthetic customer scenario: a support team sees 'delivered before handoff' records. The goal is not to reach for an agent framework but to build an authorized, explainable, auditable delivery workflow.

TEACHING CASE · SOURCE BOUNDARY

All customers, orders, timestamps and targets are fictional. Architecture is handbook synthesis; product-specific facts link to official documentation. The sample runs locally but is not production software.

AccessTenant-only, or per-order assignment?Trusted identity and row policy

FreshnessHow soon must updates be queryable?Batch versus streaming CDC

First slice: one authorized order, traceable events, read-only investigation and human sign-off. Exclude auto-refunds, arbitrary SQL and multi-agent autonomy.

These are ordered engineering boundaries, not three agents free to guess. A model does not supply or change identity, enforce database authorization, or become the source of truth.

CDC / Delta: evidence timestamps and provenance matter more than the model 03

OMS / WMS / carrier source events
  → raw append + source offset (Bronze)
  → schema / event-ID dedup / tombstone / replay (Silver)
  → governed order timeline + business semantics (Gold)
  → index only optional policy documents
FieldReasonPitfall
source_event_idReplay dedup and evidence citationConflicting payload under one ID
source_versionOrder changes within one sourceComparing different sources' versions
event_time_utcWhen source says event occurredMistaking clock skew for fact
ingested_at_utcWhen ingest observed changeUsing ingestion time as event time
tenant_idIsolation and access controlModel-supplied scope or missing RLS

Delta's first-party docs say CDF must be enabled, captures only subsequent changes and obeys retention. Long-term audit requires separate archiving; CDF is not a permanent event ledger.

Routing: exact SQL for order facts, RAG only for policy text 04

InputChosen routeWhy not the alternative
Status for order 42Scoped exact / SQLVectors cannot prove exact identity
Carrier SLA termsAuthorized BM25 / denseEvent SQL lacks unstructured policy
Missing handoffAbstain / human reviewLLMs cannot create missing evidence
Refund requestDraft + host approval; disabled in v1Model text cannot authorize business writes
trusted_identity + allowed_orders
 → authorize BEFORE retrieve
 → SQL WHERE tenant_id = ? AND order_id = ?
 → verify handoff + delivery evidence
 → ANOMALY / CONSISTENT / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
 → explain observed evidence; never issue refund
Boundary

A read-only SELECT is not automatically authorized. Enforce trusted tenant scope in the host and true row-level policy at the storage layer.

Runnable walking skeleton: one order ID, different tenants 05

Run the stdlib-only Python tests in the repository. Tenant A and tenant B both have order 42 but different timelines; results and evidence must stay separate.

cd examples/fde-order-copilot
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
python3 copilot.py

Browse runnable Python and tests

TENANT AAnomalous order 42
DELIVERED 10:20 · HANDED_OFF 10:30

Recorded chronology anomaly; not proof of physical delivery order.

TENANT BConsistent order 42
HANDED_OFF 11:00 · DELIVERED 11:30

Same ID, but isolated identity, data and evidence.

The fixture demonstrates scope filtering, duplicate replay, out-of-order arrival, insufficient evidence and denied event kinds. It does not provide production authentication, Delta, an LLM or refund APIs; it is not a production security certification.

Failure injection: repair the earliest incorrect boundary 06

Scenario A · Late or repeated carrier event

Keep event and ingestion time distinct; repeated events must be idempotent, conflicting payloads quarantined. Repair the CDC contract before changing prompts.

Scenario B · Same order ID across tenants

Deny requests without trusted tenant context. Test retrieval candidates, final evidence, caches and logs, not only the displayed answer.

Scenario C · Handoff event missing

Return INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, identify missing facts, and direct human reconciliation rather than inventing a timeline.

Scenario D · Refund tool times out

Refund is disabled in v1. If enabled later, a timeout means unknown outcome. Require approval, persisted operation IDs, idempotency contracts and reconciliation—not blind retries.

Acceptance and release: aggregate accuracy must not hide leaks 07

GateHow to testRelease decision
Tenant isolationCross-tenant, revocation, cache replayAny observed leak blocks
Evidence / abstentionGolden timelines + missing-source casesUnsupported conclusions must abstain
Data freshnessPer-source commit-to-query delayCustomer-agreed target
p95 & failuresEnd-to-end, timeouts, retries, rollbackStaged canary
Business impactHuman-reviewed time versus baselineProve actual time saved
Cost per successAll run cost / accepted correct tasksNot just token price

Hypothetical calculation: manual average 12 minutes, reviewed copilot 5 minutes, a 7-minute arithmetic saving. These are assumptions, not measured results; a real pilot must match task cohorts and track tails, abstentions and safety incidents.

Production rollout, handoff and a five-minute FDE interview answer 08

DecisionRecommended defaultWhen to change
DeploymentManaged SaaS if permittedVPC/BYOC, residency or contractual constraints
AgentDeterministic host workflowApprovals / long-lived recoverable branches
RetrievalExact SQL for IDsUnstructured contracts/policies/SLAs
ModelNo LLM for event classificationMeasured need for explanation or ambiguous evidence

Handoff requires source contracts, identity policies, versioned evals, release gates, SLOs, cost budgets, alerts, runbooks, rollback and on-call ownership. Delivery is complete when another engineer can diagnose and operate the service.

Boundary

Interview order: clarify outcome → define identity and source truth → build the thin slice → enforce refusal/safety → golden eval and unit economics → staged rollout and handoff. Don't start with a stack.

First-party sources to verify: Delta CDF · Delta Streaming · Databricks Unity Catalog · Azure Document ACL · AWS Idempotency

FDE 167-concept audit: locate evidence, not manufacture completion

Preserve the original ten tracks and route all 167 concepts to one canonical chapter. Inspect direct terminology evidence on the 2026-10-08 feature branch after stages 05–06; technical correctness and interview readiness still require separate review.

Evidence levelCountInterpretation
H99Owning heading contains concept/approved alias; not full-depth certification.
B31Owner prose contains the term/alias; depth remains unverified.
N37No direct text signal; may reflect a gap or an unmatched Chinese synonym.
Coverage is not a keyword count

Even a dedicated title still needs mechanism, scenario, trade-off, failure mode, metric and primary source checks. None of these grades alone indicates mastery.

How to use the audit

Manually review N-class entries for true gaps; then check whether H/B concepts survive engineering follow-ups. Prioritize production architecture, Databricks data flow, customer delivery, authorization and evaluation.
